_comment: Mutation baseline for high-value AI pipeline files. Uses command runner because the project uses Bun's native test runner (bun test), which has no first-party Stryker plugin. coverageAnalysis is off because command runner cannot map per-test coverage.
_sandbox_note: inPlace=true mutates files in place to avoid sandbox copy of multi-GB browser-profile dirs (data-*/rh-profile transient lockfiles). Git tracks src/ for rollback. Safe for baseline run; do not enable in CI without dirty-tree guard.
